RESEARCHER PROFILE / CURRICULUM VITAE

Youchan Choi

I research tactile sensors and robotic applications that measure contact force and position. My work covers sensor structures, circuit design, signal processing and experimental evaluation, as well as measurement and control for wearable robots.

RESEARCH EXPERIENCE

Research Experience

2025.03–2026.08

Three-axis fingertip tactile sensing

Estimated three-axis force and contact position using capacitive sensors, integrated them into a robotic hand, and applied the outputs to grasp control.

RA-L manuscript and patent in preparation

View related research ↗
2021.09–2024.02

Wearable hand robot and grasping strategy

Contributed to wearable robotic glove research on object properties and fingertip-force estimation. Developed tension/grasp-force measurement devices and actuator control.

View related research ↗
2024.03–2024.06

Wearable robot for flat back syndrome

Conducted sensing and control research for a wearable robot to assist posture and movement in people with flat back syndrome.
